text: My son is 5 months old and he's had a runny, blocked nose and been sneezing since yesterday, which I wasn't too worried about. But tonight his colour looks off to me. He's got dark skin so it's hard to tell on his face, so I checked his palms and the soles of his feet and they look much paler than normal, almost greyish. I pulled down his bottom lip and the inside of his mouth looks bluey-grey too, not the pink it usually is. His dad looked as well and agrees it's not right. I've had him under the big light and by the window to be sure it's not just the lighting. I need to know straight away if this is an ambulance job or if I take him in myself. Don't want to waste time.
